method: Actual encoded WebP displayed in Codex in-app browser: unblended 3x3 repeats, three 256x256 windows at one CSS pixel per encoded image pixel (corner, left/right and top/bottom), and neighbouring accepted road-strip-a. Native JPEG screenshots at actual 1024x768 and 390x844; full-page captures retain full seam/context views.
upscaleDisclosure: All four exports are Lanczos upscales (1.633174x), not native 2048 generations.
limitations: No asset has pixel-identical opposite edges. The prompt requested seamlessness, but output verification takes precedence.
Paving variants have different grout widths; avoid alternating A and B as though they were a matched atlas.
Lawn A and B differ slightly in colour/detail; mixed adjacency is not guaranteed seamless.
This is material QA only. Runtime scale, gameplay, iPad/Safari, FPS and PWA behaviour are integration checks.

assets.name: paving-main-a
assets.note: Preferred paving candidate. Regular warm cream grid reads continuously in 3x3 at both tested viewports; no empty boundary or large colour jump. At 100% the grout thickness/phase is slightly uneven. Edges are not pixel-identical; no mathematical seamlessness claim.
assets.colourBesideRoad: Warm cream paving, neutral grey road and yellow-green lawn remain clearly separated; no strong cast-shadow stripe or blank edge.

assets.name: paving-main-b
assets.note: Not accepted as seamless. Repeating boundaries produce narrower/interrupted horizontal grout and periodic changes in joint thickness, visible in 3x3 and 100% joins. Top/bottom boundary RGB difference is 11.16x internal P95. Colour fits the road but choose A for continuous paving until a separately authorized replacement or game review.
assets.colourBesideRoad: Warm cream paving, neutral grey road and yellow-green lawn remain clearly separated; no strong cast-shadow stripe or blank edge.

assets.name: lawn-main-a
assets.note: Calm fine lawn with clover and sparse flowers. 3x3 has no conspicuous colour blocks at tested viewports. At 100% both wrapping directions show cut leaves and small abrupt texture changes. Candidate for distant game use only after integration review; not seamless at pixel scale.
assets.colourBesideRoad: Warm cream paving, neutral grey road and yellow-green lawn remain clearly separated; no strong cast-shadow stripe or blank edge.

assets.name: lawn-main-b
assets.note: Slightly brighter, finer and denser lawn than A. 3x3 reads as an even surface at tested viewports and colour fits beside the road. At 100% cut grass/flowers and local discontinuities remain at both seams. Candidate for distant game use only after integration review; not seamless at pixel scale.
